description.value: The study investigated regional brain activation associated with cue-elicited craving and resisting the urge to smoke in treatment-seeking nicotine-dependent smokers.

design.value: Thirty-two treatment-seeking, nicotine-dependent smokers viewed blocks of smoking-related and neutral cues alternating with rest periods during fMRI scanning. Participants completed consecutive scans under instructions to allow themselves to crave and to resist the urge to smoke. The study used a block design and analyzed smoking-related cues versus neutral cues, as well as craving-versus-resisting contrasts.

description.value: Thirty-two healthy right-handed, treatment-seeking adult nicotine-dependent smokers who smoked at least 10 cigarettes per day.

clinical_characteristics.value: Participants smoked, on average, 17.7 cigarettes per day (SD=6.9). FTND scores averaged 5.6 (SD=1.9).

Participants who used contemplation of the adverse effects of continued smoking to resist craving (n=6).

task_name.value: cue-elicited craving and resisting craving task

task_description.value: Participants viewed standardized pictures of people smoking or engaged in neutral activities, as well as smoking-related and neutral objects, in alternating blocks of smoking-related images, neutral images, and rest. They completed one presentation while instructed to allow themselves to crave and a second presentation while instructed to resist the urge to smoke.

instructions.value: allow yourself to crave when you see the smoking related pictures; resist the urge to smoke when you see the smoking pictures by any means you find helpful

stimuli.value: Standardized pictures of people smoking or engaged in neutral activities, smoking-related objects such as packages of cigarettes and ashtrays, and neutral objects such as pencils and dishes.

task_performance_measures.value: self-rating of craving on a scale of 0-10
strategies employed in resisting the urge to smoke

instrument.value: 3.0 T Siemens Trio scanner (Siemens AG, Erlangen, Germany)

description.value: Standard multislice single-shot gradient echo EPI sequence with 36 ascending transverse slices and approximate AC-PC alignment.
FSL pre-statistics processing prior to analysis included removal of non-brain tissue, motion correction, spatial smoothing, grand-mean intensity normalization, and highpass temporal filtering.

steps.value: removal of non-brain with Brain Extraction Tool (BET)
spatial smoothing with a Gaussian kernel of FWHM 8 mm
grand-mean intensity normalization of the entire 4D dataset by a single multiplicative factor
highpass temporal filtering with Gaussian-weighted least-squares straight line fitting and sigma=50.0s

model_settings.value: Three levels of hierarchical analysis were completed: first-level individual data, second-level within-subject comparisons across conditions, and third-level analyses across groups. Contrasts included smoking-related cues minus neutral cues, neutral cues minus smoking-related cues, smoking-related Crave minus smoking-related Resist, and smoking-related Resist minus smoking-related Crave. Voxels were thresholded at Z>2.3 with final cluster thresholding at p=.05.

estimator.value: FILM with local autocorrelation correction; upper-level analyses used FLAME 1 random effects

model_settings.value: The random effects variance was forced to zero in FLAME; clusters were thresholded at p=.05.
